changes.title: The previously deprecated `clustermesh-ip-identities-sync-timeout` flag has been removed in favor of `clustermesh-sync-timeout`
The previously deprecated `metallb-bgp` flags `bgp-config-path`, `bgp-announce-lb-ip` and `bgp-announce-pod-cidr` have been removed
changes.detail: The previously deprecated `metallb-bgp` flags `bgp-config-path`, `bgp-announce-lb-ip` and `bgp-announce-pod-cidr` have been removed. Users are now required to use Cilium BGP control plane for BGP advertisements.

changes.title: The previously deprecated built-in WireGuard userspace-mode fallback (Helm `wireguard.userspaceFallback`) has been removed
changes.detail: The previously deprecated built-in WireGuard userspace-mode fallback (Helm `wireguard.userspaceFallback`) has been removed. Users of WireGuard transparent encryption are required to use a Linux kernel with WireGuard support.

changes.title: Helm values section `bgp.*` removed (3 keys)
changes.detail:
`bgp` of chart cilium no longer exists in v1.17.0. Remove these keys from your values and migrate the configuration they controlled; values set here no longer take effect (or are rejected when the chart validates values against a schema).
Removed keys:
bgp.announce.loadbalancerIP (default false)
bgp.announce.podCIDR (default false)
bgp.enabled (default false)

changes.title: CiliumEndpoint v2 schema: 1 field removed: `status.visibility-policy-status`
changes.detail:
Fields no longer in the cilium.io/v2 schema of ciliumendpoints.cilium.io are pruned from stored objects and rejected or dropped in manifests. Remove them from your resources.
Removed paths:
status.visibility-policy-status

changes.title: Cilium could previously be run in a configuration where the Etcd instances that distribute Cilium state between nodes would be managed in pod network by Cilium…
changes.detail: Cilium could previously be run in a configuration where the Etcd instances that distribute Cilium state between nodes would be managed in pod network by Cilium itself. This support, which had been previously deprecated as complicated and error prone, has now been removed. Refer to k8s_install_etcd for alternatives for running Cilium with Etcd.

changes.title: Cilium now supports services protocol differentiation, which allows the agent to distinguish two services on the same port with different protocols (e.g. TCP…
changes.detail: Cilium now supports services protocol differentiation, which allows the agent to distinguish two services on the same port with different protocols (e.g. TCP and UDP). This feature, enabled by default, can be controlled with the `--bpf-lb-proto-diff` flag. After the upgrade, existing services without a protocol set will be preserved as such, to avoid any connection disruptions, and will need to be deleted and recreated in order for their protocol to be taken into account by the agent. In case of downgrades to a version that doesn't support services protocol differentiation, existing services with the protocol set will be deleted and recreated, without the protocol, by the agent, causing connection disruptions for such services.

changes.title: For IPsec, support for a single key has been removed
changes.detail: For IPsec, support for a single key has been removed. Per-tunnel keys will now be used regardless of the presence of the `+` sign in the secret.

changes.title: Layer 7 policy support for Cassandra and Memcached have been deprecated and their getting started guides have been removed
MTU auto-detection is now continuous during agent lifetime, changing device MTU no longer requires restarting the agent to pick up the new MTU
MTU auto-detection will now use the lowest MTU of all external interfaces
changes.detail: MTU auto-detection will now use the lowest MTU of all external interfaces. Before, only the primary interface was considered. One exception to this is in ENI mode where the secondary interfaces are not considered for MTU auto-detection. MTU can still be configured manually via the `MTU` helm option, `--mtu` agent flag or `mtu` option in CNI configuration.

changes.title: Operating Cilium in `--datapath-mode=lb-only` for plain Docker mode now requires to add an additional `--enable-k8s=false` to the command line, otherwise it is…
changes.detail: Operating Cilium in `--datapath-mode=lb-only` for plain Docker mode now requires to add an additional `--enable-k8s=false` to the command line, otherwise it is assumed that Kubernetes is present.

changes.title: Support for Consul, deprecated since v1.12, has been removed
Support for L7 protocol visibility using Pod annotations (`policy.cilium.io/proxy-visibility`), deprecated since v1.15, has been removed
Support for `metallb-bgp`, deprecated since 1.14, has been removed
TLS Visibility can now pass secrets to Envoy via SDS instead of inline via NPDS
changes.detail: TLS Visibility can now pass secrets to Envoy via SDS instead of inline via NPDS. This comes with some configuration changes: * The Helm value `tls.secretsBackend`, which could be set to `local` or `k8s` (which would grant the Agent read access to all Secrets in the cluster so it could send Secrets inline) has been deprecated and replaced with `tls.readSecretsOnlyFromSecretsNamespace`, which defaults to `true` (the agent can only read TLS Visibility Secrets from the namespace configured in the new `tls.secretsNamespace` setting) or `false` (the agent can read TLS Visibility Secrets from anywhere in the cluster, equivalent to `tls.secretsBackend: k8s`) * A new Helm value `tls.secretSync` has been added, which controls if TLS Visibility Secrets will be synchronized to the configured secrets namespace (`tls.secretsNamespace.name`) by the Cilium Operator, and if SDS will be used. SDS usage requires that secret synchronization be enabled. * The defaults for new clusters enable SDS via `tls.readSecretsOnlyFromSecretsNamespace: true` and `tls.secretSync.enabled: true` * The defaults for upgraded clusters (where `upgradeCompatibility` is `v1.16`) do not enable SDS. They are…

changes.title: The Cilium cluster name validation cannot be bypassed anymore, both for the local and remote clusters
changes.detail: The Cilium cluster name validation cannot be bypassed anymore, both for the local and remote clusters. The cluster name is strictly enforced to consist of at most 32 lower case alphanumeric characters and '-', start and end with an alphanumeric character.

changes.title: The Cilium status API now reports the KVStore subsystem with `Disabled` state when disabled, instead of `OK` state and `Disabled` message
The Helm option `hubble.relay.dialTimeout` has been deprecated (now a no-op) and will be removed in Cilium 1.18
The Helm options `hubble.tls.server.cert`, `hubble.tls.server.key`, `hubble.relay.tls.client.cert`, `hubble.relay.tls.client.key`, `hubble.relay.tls.server.cer…
changes.detail: The Helm options `hubble.tls.server.cert`, `hubble.tls.server.key`, `hubble.relay.tls.client.cert`, `hubble.relay.tls.client.key`, `hubble.relay.tls.server.cert`, `hubble.relay.tls.server.key`, `hubble.ui.tls.client.cert`, and `hubble.ui.tls.client.key` have been deprecated in favor of the associated `existingSecret` options and will be removed in a future release.

changes.title: The Kubernetes clients used by Cilium Agent and Cilium Operator now have separately configurable rate limits
changes.detail: The Kubernetes clients used by Cilium Agent and Cilium Operator now have separately configurable rate limits. The default rate limit for Cilium Operator K8s clients has been increased to 100 QPS/200 Burst. To configure the rate limit for Cilium Operator, use the `--operator-k8s-client-qps` and `--operator-k8s-client-burst` flags or the corresponding Helm values.

changes.title: The `CONNTRACK_LOCAL` option has been deprecated and will be removed in a future release
The `metallb-bgp` integration Helm options `bgp.enabled`, `bgp.announce.podCIDR`, and `bgp.announce.loadbalancerIP` have been removed
changes.detail: The `metallb-bgp` integration Helm options `bgp.enabled`, `bgp.announce.podCIDR`, and `bgp.announce.loadbalancerIP` have been removed. Users are now required to use Cilium BGP control plane options available under `bgpControlPlane` for BGP announcements.

changes.title: The default value of `dnsProxy.endpointMaxIpPerHostname` and its corresponding agent option has been increased from 50 to 1000 to reflect improved scaling of…
changes.detail: The default value of `dnsProxy.endpointMaxIpPerHostname` and its corresponding agent option has been increased from 50 to 1000 to reflect improved scaling of toFQDNs policies and to better handle domains which return a large number of IPs with short TTLs.

changes.title: The default value of `hubble.tls.auto.certValidityDuration` has been lowered from 1095 days to 365 days because recent versions of MacOS will fail to validate…
changes.detail: The default value of `hubble.tls.auto.certValidityDuration` has been lowered from 1095 days to 365 days because recent versions of MacOS will fail to validate certificates with expirations longer than 825 days.

changes.title: The flag `k8s-mode` (and related flags `cilium-agent-container-name`, `k8s-namespace` & `k8s-label`) have been deprecated and will be removed in a Cilium 1.18
changes.detail: The flag `k8s-mode` (and related flags `cilium-agent-container-name`, `k8s-namespace` & `k8s-label`) have been deprecated and will be removed in a Cilium 1.18. Cilium CLI should be used to gather a sysdump from a K8s cluster.

changes.title: The option to run a synchronous probe using `cilium-health status --probe` is no longer supported, and is now a hidden option that returns the results of the…
changes.detail: The option to run a synchronous probe using `cilium-health status --probe` is no longer supported, and is now a hidden option that returns the results of the most recent cached probe. It will be removed in a future release.

changes.title: the `--cluster` behavior changed to show flows emitted from nodes outside of the provided cluster name (either coming from or going to the target cluster)
changes.detail: the `--cluster` behavior changed to show flows emitted from nodes outside of the provided cluster name (either coming from or going to the target cluster). This change brings consistency between the `--cluster` and `--namespace` flags and removed the incompatibility between the `--cluster` and `--node-name` flags. The previous behavior of `--cluster foo` can be reproduced with `--node-name foo/` (shows all flows emitted from a node in cluster `foo`).

changes.title: `cilium_cidrgroup_translation_time_stats_seconds` has been removed, as the measured code path no longer exists
The External Workloads feature has been deprecated and will be removed in v1.18
The `--enable-k8s-terminating-endpoint` cilium-agent flag (`enableK8sTerminatingEndpoint` in Helm) has been deprecated
changes.detail: The `--enable-k8s-terminating-endpoint` cilium-agent flag (`enableK8sTerminatingEndpoint` in Helm) has been deprecated. The feature will be unconditionally enabled in v1.18.

changes.title: The `--k8s-watcher-endpoint-selector` cilium-agent flag didn't have any effect since v1.14 and has been deprecated
changes.detail: The `--k8s-watcher-endpoint-selector` cilium-agent flag didn't have any effect since v1.14 and has been deprecated. It will be remove in v1.18.

changes.title: The `cilium-docker-plugin` has been deprecated and is planned to be removed in v1.18
The high-scale mode for ipcache has been deprecated and will be removed in v1.18
The hubble-relay flag `--dial-timeout` has been deprecated (now a no-op) and will be removed in Cilium 1.18
`cilium_node_connectivity_latency_seconds` is now deprecated
changes.detail: `cilium_node_connectivity_latency_seconds` is now deprecated. Please use `cilium_node_health_connectivity_latency_seconds` instead.

changes.title: `cilium_node_connectivity_status` is now deprecated
changes.detail: `cilium_node_connectivity_status` is now deprecated. Please use `cilium_node_health_connectivity_status` instead.
